resources.string:
A plugin for Drivelog. It reads the odometer, fuel, range and tyre pressures of your motorcycle from the maker's app on this phone, which gets them from the motorcycle when it disconnects.

How to use it: in Android's accessibility settings, turn on "Drivelog Ride". In Drivelog, open the motorcycle, choose Edit and set the plugin Drivelog Ride. After a ride, the next time you unlock the phone, the plugin opens the maker's app for a few seconds, taps the motorcycle for its details, reads them and goes back to the home screen: Drivelog takes the values as the end of the ride. You can also open the app and tap the motorcycle yourself.

The plugin reads only that app's screens, and only the motorcycle's values on them. The tap on the motorcycle is the only thing it does there; it never types.
